# Imagegen CLI snapshot

`image_gen.py` is an unmodified snapshot of `scripts/image_gen.py` distributed with the locally installed OpenAI system `imagegen` skill, exported on 2026-11-12. The original upstream commit was not recorded.

The accompanying `LICENSE.txt` is copied unchanged from that skill and contains the Apache License, Version 2.0. This license applies to this third-party snapshot.

The snapshot allows installation on a machine missing the system CLI. Installation must preserve an existing system CLI; the provider wrapper remains unchanged and continues to delegate to the system path.
